rule: Only direct paragraph children of those uniquely identified sections. No recursive descendants, Background, Technical Validation, geometry validation, quantum-results validation, figures, supplementary material or model-performance prose.
numeric_handling: Mask digit-bearing tokens before prose display. Computational method/basis labels and file/property schema indices or units may later be preserved as documentary metadata, never target examples or accuracy values.
tables: Inspect only header cells of t2/t3 first. t1 validation table is prohibited. t2/t3 body cells remain withheld unless headers verify a file-layout/property-unit dictionary rather than observations.
license: Primary article's CC BY-NC-SA and metadata-only CC0 footer are not generalized to dataset files. Collection registry currently declares CC BY4; constituent-data rights remain unknown.
